GlowBeat Table Clock With Bluetooth Speaker

Upgrade your everyday lifestyle with the GlowBeat Table Clock With Bluetooth Speaker, a smart all-in-one device that combines premium sound, intelligent time management, and modern design. Perfect for bedrooms, offices, study tables, and gifting, this innovative product seamlessly blends a Bluetooth 5 speaker + alarm clock + LED mirror display into a compact, stylish unit.

Designed for convenience and performance, the GlowBeat table clock delivers crystal-clear audio while functioning as a reliable alarm clock and digital time display. Whether you are waking up to your favorite music, taking hands-free calls, or enjoying FM radio, this multifunctional Bluetooth speaker clock is built to enhance your daily routine.

Smart Design with LED Mirror Display

The sleek LED mirror display adds a modern aesthetic while offering excellent visibility day and night. The brightness is easy on the eyes, making it ideal as a bedside clock or desk accessory. The mirror-finish screen not only displays time clearly but also complements contemporary interiors.

Powerful Bluetooth 5 Audio Performance

Equipped with advanced Bluetooth 5 technology, the ensures fast pairing, stable connectivity, and low power consumption. Enjoy immersive sound quality for music, podcasts, and calls with minimal distortion, whether connected to smartphones, tablets, or laptops.

Hands-Free Calling & Multi-Mode Playback

Stay connected effortlessly with built-in hands-free calling support. The integrated microphone allows you to answer calls directly through the speaker, making it ideal for work-from-home setups. Multiple playback options including FM radio, AUX input, and TF card support ensure uninterrupted entertainment without depending solely on Bluetooth.

Reliable Alarm Clock for Daily Use

Never miss an important moment with the precise digital feature. Set alarms easily and wake up refreshed every morning. The combination of audio and visual alerts makes this suitable for heavy sleepers, students, and professionals alike.

Long-Lasting Battery & USB Charging

Powered by a high-capacity 1400 mAh battery, the GlowBeat clock speaker delivers extended playback time on a single charge. The convenient USB charging feature ensures quick and hassle-free recharging, making it portable and travel-friendly.

Why Choose?

  • All-in-one Bluetooth 5 speaker, alarm clock, and LED mirror display
  • Clear, powerful sound with stable wireless connectivity
  • Hands-free calling with built-in microphone
  • Supports FM radio, AUX input, and TF card playback
  • 1400 mAh rechargeable battery for long-lasting use
  • USB charging for convenience and portability
  • Ideal for bedroom, office, study table, and gifting

Perfect for Home, Office & Gifting

The is a versatile solution for modern users who value functionality and style. Its compact size, premium finish, and smart features make it an excellent choice for personal use or as a thoughtful gift for birthdays, festivals, and corporate events. Whether you are looking for a with a digital LED or a multifunctional bedside speaker, GlowBeat delivers exceptional value and performance in one elegant device.
